mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about District and Metropolitan Planning Committees: 1. Not less than four-fifths of the members of a District Planning Committee are elected by and from among the elected members of the district panchayat and municipalities. 2. Four-fifths of the members of a Metropolitan Planning Committee are elected. 3. The elected seats of a District Planning Committee are shared in the ratio of the rural and urban population of the district. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq_fix.why: Art. 243ZD: not less than four-fifths elected, not 'up to'

patterns: Direct one-liners dominate: chairman of NDC/Planning Commission = PM, NDC year 1952, 'Planned Economy for India' = Visvesvaraya, NPC set up by Bose.

APPSC tests function-to-body attribution with close wording: 'guidelines incl. assessment of resources' = NDC; tax share = Finance Commission; current allocation of central funds = Union Finance Ministry.
Recurring traps: NDC/Planning Commission non-constitutional and non-statutory (Zonal Councils statutory); Finance Commission Chairman not an NDC member.
Economic planning is in the Concurrent List (Entry 20); NDC is final approver of Five-Year Plans.
App leans heavily on multi-statement items and AP-specific planning trivia; PYQs are mostly single-fact.
